notes.title: Camp Blitz - Patch 1.017
notes.notes:
Spice Road lends itself to a wide variety of strategies, and so it is hard to test for all eventualities. Patch 1.017 fixes a bug that is only triggered by a quick land-grab with many tightly packed camps, which are all expanded to towns (with the bug shifting borders when you defeat a bandit camp).

I'm happy that players are still finding new ways to play (and break!) Spice Road.

notes.title: Spice Road - Patch 1.015 Released
notes.notes:
Spice Road development continues with the new 1.015 Patch, adding a new feature to Sandbox play and fixing a couple of bugs that hampered building really huge cities.

Here is a summary of all the updates so far:

CHANGELIST v1.015
Fixed type in mission 12
Fixed Auto-Build for large buildings
Added Resource Hints to Sandbox

CHANGELIST v1.014
Fix caravan camel numbers when using shortcut keys to cycle buildings.
Keep Upgrade Town UI open when switching towns.

CHANGELIST v1.013
Fixed missing cursor in fullscreen, there is now an option to use a hardware cursor on the settings page. 

CHANGELIST v1.011
Swap WASD with Arrow keys to scroll - There is an option at the bottom the of Options screen.
Added an option to reverse the effect of the Mousewheel zoom - some people find it more natural to zoom in by scrolling up. 

CHANGELIST v1.010
New upgrade UI available on Town screen for quick upgrading of whole town, or individual buildings.
Apartments fixed to show they require a Town to build.
Fixed tax objective not triggering in Mission 6.
Added "Cheat Code" to play with all buildings unlocked in Sandbox.

CHANGELIST v1.009
Fixed Palace/Slavequarters/Scouthuts upgrade path to stop wasting upgrade points.

CHANGELIST v1.008
Fix DirectX warning on quit.

CHANGELIST v1.007
Fixed Mission 4 objectives status
Added more Bandits to Mission 4

CHANGELIST v1.006
Keep building selection and Zoom level when cycling buildings.

CHANGELIST v1.005
Fixed objective text.

CHANGELIST v1.004
Fixed City Cycling shortcut key

CHANGELIST v1.002

Fixed extra objective "Defeat all Factions" - Was not being marked complete when it should have been.

CHANGELIST v1.001

Building Categories show full info for both paired building types.
Building category Hotkeys 1,2,3,4,5

Z,X cycle through your towns.

C,V cycles through buildings of different types
F,G cycles through buildings of the same type

Press T for Townhall status page
press Y for Warehouse status page

Main map has sidebar with caravan list. Caravans filled to capacity are marked, and you can add camels directly
using the side bar, or open up a context menu to go to the Tradepost or set a new route.

Caravan routes are now in bold when selected.

There is a "Destroy $###" button at the top of the building panels.
Partially used resources appear as 1/2 filled.
Press R to rotate a building before placing.
Hint at end of mission if there are hidden -???- objectives
Fixed "Furs Bug"
